confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not live listings; no web search was used for prices. Restaurant anchors are moderately certain, while hostel and hotel rates vary widely by neighbourhood and season and are less certain. Cocktail and wine are set at about 2.3 times the beer anchor because direct bar-price knowledge is weak. FX: the 13 Oct 2026 RBA observation came from a search excerpt attributed to the RBA overview page, not a direct page read; a 14 Oct 2026 reading may exist but could not be confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Based on general Colombian tourist-city price levels (for example Medellin and Caribbean coastal tourism pricing), with an upward adjustment for the Cartagena Old Town and Getsemani tourist premium and July high-season demand. Cocktail and wine are anchored to the beer price relationship.
